decision: Accept for substantial descriptor file batch gains with explicit measured costs; no universal speedup claim.

scope: Only frozen C1 source/binaries are accepted here. HEAD has independently advanced to3ea936d with CLI grouping/CI fixtures; this receipt does not validate that newer executable. A separately captured bridge is required before further optimization.
tradeoff_rationale: Large 10,000-file and56-file native improvements justify these bounded costs for descriptor batch workloads. The final combined build must remeasure all workloads; no claim that unrelated workloads are unchanged.
